episodes.title: The Flash of Lightning Before It Thunders
episodes.summary: Unlike her friends, Kim Jojo has more pressing things on her mind than dating. Upon returning from abroad, Hwang Sun Oh goes to see Lee Hye Young.

episodes.title: There's Nothing Anyone Can Do When You Like Someone
episodes.summary: Sun Oh wants to know whether Hye Young has feelings for Jojo and tells him what he did. Jang Il Shik gets into a fight with Sun Oh and Hye Young.

episodes.title: The Miracle of Two People Liking Each Other
episodes.summary: Jojo confronts Sun Oh about the photos. As rumors spread at school, Jang Go gets mad at Jojo for lying. Il Shik confronts Jang Go about what she did.

episodes.title: The Best Feeling in the World Is Knowing There's Someone on My Side
episodes.summary: Sun Oh asks Jojo about the school trip and realizes there's not much he can do for her. Il Shik tells Jang Go something she doesn't want to hear.

episodes.title: The Gravity of Liking Someone
episodes.summary: Jojo tells Sun Oh about her parents and makes a surprising suggestion. She later confronts Jang Go after overhearing something.

episodes.title: Your Heart Is Safe Now
episodes.summary: News of the tragedy hits the airwaves. Hye Young finds Jojo at the library and informs her that he plans to court her the old-fashioned way.

episodes.title: Something I've Been Holding Back and Can Only Say to You
episodes.summary: Jojo tries to put a shield around herself and tells Hye Young she doesn't need his help, but he offers to take her somewhere special.

episodes.title: One Is Bigger Than Any Other Number in the World
episodes.summary: Jojo ponders what it means to like someone and realizes a shield may not be necessary. Sun Oh wants to know whether she still has feelings for him.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Curious about her true feelings for Hye Young, Jojo returns to her alma mater in search of information on Chon Duk Goo — and runs into her past.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Jojo asks Brian Chon about the shield at an event attended by the Badge Club members, including Sun Oh. Hye Young comes face-to-face with his father.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Jojo offers Hye Young a shoulder to cry on after a punishing day. Unable to cope with knowledge of the shield, Sun Oh turns to Jojo for the truth.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: With video of his lecture hall visit gone viral, Sun Oh comes to blows with Hye Young. Jojo receives a special gift from an unknown sender.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Park Gul Mi reaches a digital milestone. Brian grills Jojo about the shield, spear and Duk Goo — and shatters reality for a bystanding listener.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Revealing the identity and inspiration behind The Ringing World, Jojo reconciles with the past. Duk Goo keeps his end of the bargain.
